facts.fact_text: The disciplinary sanction of reprimand imposed on the applicant on 29 June 2009 was imposed under Article 125 of Law no. 657 on Civil Servants.
A full description of relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in Karaçay v. Turkey (no. 6615/03, §§ 14-17, 27 March 2007).
A full description of relevant domestic law at the material time can be found in İsmail Sezer v. Turkey (no. 36807/07, §§ 14-21, 24 March 2015).
